Drop table dw.DimCustomerNameURL_CBG_UT;

select 
    concat(dc.customername, ' - ',dc.customerid) as NameID,
    dc.customerid as CustomerID,
    case when dc.customertype in('Retail','RETAIL') then concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/a2a79061-95be-4df1-ba36-add043fa126a/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''') 
            ELSE  concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/d845e37d-44a1-4bd2-a084-c01a0034cbf2/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''')
     END as URL
into dw.DimCustomerNameURL_CBG_UT
from dw.dimcustomernametest dc
where dc.customerid in (select distinct customerid from dw.dimcustomeraccount dca
                    where (dca.sourcesystemcode = 'CCD'
                        or dca.sourcesystemcode = 'LNS')
                    AND dca.currentindicator = 1
                    and dca.banksk = 1)
